title: "One Minute After You Die – Where Will You Be?" 🔥
paragraphs: "One Minute After You Die – Where Will You Be?" 🔥

🔥 IMAGINE THIS: YOU TAKE YOUR LAST BREATH… AND SUDDENLY, YOU’RE STANDING BEFORE GOD.
⏳ No more excuses. No more second chances. No more time to repent.

🚨 In one minute, your eternity is sealed—FOREVER.
Heaven or hell. Eternal joy or eternal torment. The choice is no longer yours.
📖 "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment." (Hebrews 9:27)
💀 Are you ready? Or will you regret every moment you ignored God?

🔥 1. WHAT HAPPENS IMMEDIATELY AFTER YOU DIE?
📖 "And in Hades, being in torment, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side." (Luke 16:23)

🚨 THE MOMENT YOU DIE, TWO THINGS HAPPEN:
✅ If you are saved – You are immediately in the presence of Jesus.
🔥 If you are lost – You instantly enter a place of suffering and separation from God.
💀 There is no in-between. No reincarnation. No second chances.
📖 "We must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ." (2 Corinthians 5:10)
🚨 The question is: Are YOU ready?

🔥 2. SATAN’S BIGGEST LIE: “YOU HAVE MORE TIME”
📖 "You do not know what tomorrow will bring." (James 4:14)

😨 The devil doesn’t need you to reject Jesus—he just needs you to DELAY your decision.
⏳ "I’ll repent later…" – But what if later never comes?
⏳ "I’m a good person, I’ll be fine." – But "good" isn’t good enough.
⏳ "God knows my heart." – Yes… and that should terrify you!
🔥 Hell is full of people who thought they had more time.
📖 "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord’… but I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me.’" (Matthew 7:22-23)
🚨 DO NOT GAMBLE WITH YOUR SOUL.

🔥 3. HOW TO KNOW YOU’RE READY FOR ETERNITY
🙌 God doesn’t want anyone to perish—He made a way for YOU!

✅ 1. REPENT AND BELIEVE IN JESUS – There is NO OTHER WAY.
📖 "Jesus said, ‘I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’" (John 14:6)

✅ 2. TURN FROM SIN – You cannot follow Jesus and continue in rebellion.
📖 "Unless you repent, you will all likewise perish." (Luke 13:3)

✅ 3. LIVE HOLY AND STAY FAITHFUL – Salvation is not just a one-time prayer.
📖 "The one who endures to the end will be saved." (Matthew 24:13)
🔥 TODAY IS THE DAY OF SALVATION. YOU ARE NOT PROMISED TOMORROW.

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if you believe in Jesus!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you love Jesus!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to spread this urgent message!

🔥 THE ETERNITY CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly saved? If not, repent today.
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this urgent warning!

📢 🚨 WARNING: The enemy does NOT want you to share this.
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 21, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I come before You with a humble heart. I recognize that life is short, and eternity is forever. Lord, open my eyes to the truth and help me never to take my time on earth for granted. If I have been lukewarm, wake me up. If I have been lost, bring me back. I repent of my sins and choose to follow Jesus with all my heart. Help me to warn others while there is still time. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
